title: Skip Setup Items
description: Skips Setup Assistant screens shown after updates or when a user logs in for the first time.

SkipAccessibility.title: Skip accessibility
SkipAccessibility.description: If true, the system skips the Accessibility pane.

SkipAppearance.title: Skip appearance
SkipAppearance.description: If true, the system skips the Choose Your Look pane.

SkipCloudSetup.title: Skip cloud setup
SkipCloudSetup.description: If true, the system skips the Apple Account setup pane.

SkipPrivacySetup.title: Skip privacy setup
SkipPrivacySetup.description: If true, the system skips the Privacy consent pane.

SkipScreenTime.title: Skip Screen Time
SkipScreenTime.description: If true, the system skips the Screen Time pane.

SkipSetupItems.title: Skip setup items
SkipSetupItems.description: An array of strings that describe the setup items to skip. SkipKeys provides a list of valid strings and their meanings.

SkipSiriSetup.title: Skip Siri setup
SkipSiriSetup.description: If true, the system skips the Siri setup pane.

SkipTouchIDSetup.title: Skip Touch ID setup
SkipTouchIDSetup.description: If true, the system skips the Touch ID setup pane.

SkipTrueTone.title: Skip true tone
SkipTrueTone.description: If true, the system skips the True Tone Display pane.

SkipUnlockWithWatch.title: Skip unlock with watch
SkipUnlockWithWatch.description: If true, the system skips the Unlock With Apple Watch pane.

SkipWallpaper.title: Skip wallpaper
SkipWallpaper.description: If 'true', the system skips the Wallpaper selection window.

SkipiCloudStorageSetup.title: SkipiCloud storage setup
SkipiCloudStorageSetup.description: If true, the system skips the iCloud Storage pane.
